description: This file defines the TimezoneAPI class, a REST API controller for handling timezone-related requests within the installer module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides a method to retrieve a list of timezones.

classes.name: TimezoneAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for fetching timezone data during the installation process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve timezone data by calling InstanceCreationHelper::getTimezones.
